summary: A completed questionnaire determines whether a candidate appears on the committee’s eligibility list.
realLife: At the August 2023 meeting, the 34th Democrats displayed only candidates who had completed the county party’s questionnaire.
inGame: needs: the submission record, eligibility rule and list shown at the meeting.

turns.what: The secretary checks the receipt against the rule.
turns.pulledBy: A candidate missing from the slide produces an accepted submission.
turns.writesBack: A corrected list can be put before the members.

turns.what: The chair explains why the name is missing.
turns.pulledBy: The committee finds no completed submission.
turns.writesBack: The list stays as presented for this endorsement vote.
